provenance.kind: cross-implementation vectors generated by this repo (NOT official NIST vectors; see acvp-ml-kem-768.json for those)
provenance.note: K-PKE.Encrypt/Decrypt are deterministic given (key, message, coins) and byte-identical between wasm and kyber-py. K-PKE key GENERATION is not (pqc_kyber derives keys as G(d), FIPS 203 as G(d||k)), so keys are cross-checked by interoperability, not equality.
